text:
sara: quick sync request — we need to prioritize slice-affinity routing for the long-term roadmap. customer asks (FinCorp, EduLabs) pushing for strict tenant isolation + cross-region failover. thoughts?
ben: +1. main tradeoff is utilization vs isolation. if we do hard affinity we lose packing.
irene: can we do soft affinity first? prefer best-effort locality, then opt-in strict slices for enterprise customers. cheaper and faster to ship.
ajay: soft affinity sounds good. we should define launch criteria: 99th pct latency uplift < 15%, isolation test coverage > 90%, migration rollback plan.
sara: exactly. also need policy primitives: route-priority, tenant-labels, prefer-region, fallback-tier. small API sketch: 
```
route_policy {
  priority: regional_affinity
  fallback: global_best_effort
  labels: ["enterprise", "pci"]
}
```
ben: implementation notes: runtime needs lease-based assignments for hard slices, and a scoring function for soft affinity. KV-cache affinity important for seq-heavy workloads.
irene: ops ask: telemetry hooks per-tenant + per-route cost breakdown. we need to show token-cost delta before enabling strict slices.
ajay: for canary we do 5% of traffic -> validate latency and error budget over 48h. rollback if errors > 0.5% or cost delta > 20%.
sara: prioritization matrix suggestion:
- P0: opt-in hard slices for Dedicated customers (legal/compliance driven)
- P1: soft affinity platform-wide (lower dev effort)
- P2: automated tenant-tiling recommendations (Optimize integration)
ben: timeline: soft affinity prototype in 6 wks, hard-slice alpha for Dedicated in 12 wks. need infra headcount + storage for slice map.
irene: dependencies: billing changes, console UI for toggle, and rollout playbook for customers. ops runbook draft?
ajay: I'll draft a runbook itemizing tests: isolation smoke, cross-region failover, KV-consistency, cache-warmup.
sara: good. decision points for leadership: acceptable utilization loss threshold and price uplift for strict slices. can we quantify?
ben: rough calc: worst-case utilization loss 18-25% for small clusters; we can mitigate with burst pools.
irene: customers willing to pay 15-25% premium for isolation (heard from sales). match pricing to utilization hit.
sara: next steps: Ajay & Ben to produce an infra BOM + telemetry plan by next Tue. Irene to gather 3 customer LOEs for migration and pricing feedback. I'll consolidate into a PRI ticket for roadmap.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: routing-sim-v1 -> canary (5%) at 2026-04-02T09:00Z :rocket:
sara: thanks — tagging @eng-sre for oncall awareness. we'll run a follow-up sync Thurs 10am. :calendar:
